title: Street Spirit (Fade Out)
feel: Continuous arpeggio: bass note, then open G / open E / moving B-string note

sections.name: Figure 1 (Am)
sections.note: Each figure is one 4/4 bar, drawn here one beat per box. The B-string note moves 1 → 3 → 1 → 0.

sections.name: Intro
sections.note: From here on, Am = Figure 1, Em = Figure 2, C = Figure 3.

sections.name: Verse
sections.bars: Am | Em | Am | Am | C | Em

why: An arpeggio with a **moving inner voice** (sus4 → minor → sus2) under fixed fingers: voice motion inside one shape.
hard_change: Keeping the **right-hand pattern even at 138** while the left hand changes figure. The fretting hand only ever moves one finger at a time.
theory: i–v–III (Am–Em–C), Aeolian. Every change inside a figure is a suspension (4–3, 2–1).
steps: Changes alone, slowly: each figure as four block chords, then arpeggiated.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 96 bpm), eighth-note arpeggio.
tips: Tabs call the third Em-figure chord “Em6”; with C on the B string it is really C/E. Corrected here.
